text: Army of LoRAs. Type one prompt in ComfyUI, and an army of sixty-five community LoRAs decides how to render it, across five open image and video models.
Hugging Face has thousands of great LoRAs. But which one fits your prompt, on which base model, at what strength, with which trigger word?

So the router decides. The prompt is embedded with pybed, our static int-eight embedding model. There's no transformer, just a token lookup, so it takes about two milliseconds on the CPU. It scores every LoRA's description, picks image or video, and deploys the model whose army fits best.
I scraped seven hundred and fifty-five adapters, dropped anything adult, any likeness or franchise, and anything unlicensed, then hand-picked sixty-five.

prompt: a cute sticker of a red panda eating ramen, pixel art
text: A sticker of a red panda, in pixel art. FLUX klein, with the Stickers and Pixel Art LoRAs drafted together, one per role.

prompt: isometric diorama of a cozy wizard library with floating books
text: An isometric diorama gets the Isometric LoRA.

prompt: a crochet amigurumi octopus reading a newspaper on a wooden table
text: Crochet amigurumi, straight from the community.

prompt: a vintage travel poster that says "VISIT THE MOON" in bold retro letters
text: Lettering goes to Qwen Image, with no style LoRA at all, so the text stays clean.

prompt: synthwave outrun sunset over a chrome city with a palm-lined highway
text: Synthwave on Qwen, with an Outrun LoRA.

prompt: a monet style garden with a wooden footbridge over a lily pond
text: Painterly prompts go to MOSS Image. Monet's garden, with an impressionism LoRA.

prompt: shot on kodachrome, a 1950s roadside diner at dusk with a red convertible
gouache storybook illustration of a fox and a badger sharing tea in the rain
16-bit pixel art video of a fox running through a forest at dusk
text: When the prompt moves, it becomes a video. A sixteen-bit fox on MiniMax H3, with sound.

prompt: video of a knight and a wizard walking through an enchanted forest, 1980s fantasy movie
text: An eighties fantasy movie look, plus a human motion LoRA.

prompt: a paper boat transforms into a glowing koi fish as it drifts down a rainy street, cinematic video
text: And a transformation on LTX two point three, with a transition LoRA.
In ComfyUI it's one graph with all five models. Lazy inputs mean only the routed model ever loads, and each drafted LoRA downloads from its author on first use.
Everything is open source: the nodes, workflows, catalog, and credits for every LoRA author. Army of LoRAs, for ComfyUI.
